evals.prompt: Screens under src/features/ use different labels and icons for the save button. Check HIG compliance
evals.expected_output: It checks against the UI glossary and the 8 HIG categories and writes a report with a unified fix for every MUST finding to output/reports/review/HIG_COMPLIANCE_.
assertions: A report starting with HIG_COMPLIANCE_ exists under output/reports/review/
Inconsistencies in the button and icon categories are listed per screen
Every MUST finding has a unified fix
A HIG compliance score is shown

evals.prompt: Run the HIG check and fix it with --fix. No need to run the tests
evals.expected_output: After the --fix changes it runs the tests and shows the result; if no test tooling exists, it records N/A with the reason.
assertions: Test results after the fix are shown, or N/A with a reason when no test tooling exists
Each change is mapped to its finding
